༄༅/ /zab bdun rtsa gsum tshe'i zab pa las/pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i phrin las sngon 'gro khyer bde bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// zab bdun rtsa gsum tshe'i zab pa las/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i phrin las sngon 'gro khyer bde bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī yai/ rtsa gsum tshe yi zab pa las// dbang mdzad pad+ma mkha' 'gro yi// sngon 'gro zab bdun spyi chings las/ khyer bde zur bkol 'dod pa na// thog mar brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni// bde chen pad+ma'i rigs mchog snang mtha' yas// 'jig rten dbang phyug pad+ma gar gyi dbang*/ khams gsum dbang mdzad rta mchog yab yum la// gsol ba 'debs so snang sems dbang sgyur shog /snang srid zil gnon pad+ma rgyal po'i zhabs// dbyings phyug ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma// mnga' bdag chos rgyal khri lde yab sras la// gsol ba 'debs so snang sems dbang sgyur shog /'gro 'dul sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur gling*// bka' babs lung thob rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can gter srung la// gsol ba 'debs so snang sems dbang sgyur shog /rang rig 'gyur med ye grol lhun 'byams ngang*// rig rtsal snang srid 'khor 'das dbang du 'dus// snang sems gnyis med nyag gcig chos sku'i klong*// bya byed rtsol sgrub bral ba'i gding thob shog / gnyis pa skyabs sems gter gzhung ni/ na mo: rgyal kun 'dus gzugs bla ma mkha' 'gro mar: gus pas skyabs mchi sems can kun don du: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen skyong ba la: 'di na bshad cing sgrub pa byed pa yi: dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rnams bsdu ba dang: chos kyi cha rkyen ma lus bsdu ba'i phyir: bla ma mkha' 'gro bsgrub par dam bca' bas: dka' ba med par dus 'dir 'grub par shog: lan gsum brjod/ bgegs gtor byin brlabs sngags kyis bsngo/ gsum pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba/ hrīḥhūm̐/ nga ni rang byung pad+ma he ru ka /'khor 'das kun la dbang sgyur rdo rje'i bka'// ma 'da' rtog 'khrul bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// ye stong rtsa bral gnyug ma'i dbyings su dengs// sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha phaṭa/ bzhi pa srung mtshams gcad pa ni/

hūm̐/ gdod nas rnam dag ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir// mtshan 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bar chad ming yang med// snang grags rtog tshogs lha sngags 'od gsal dbyings// 'ja' zer phyag mtshan me phung 'bar bas gtams// badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ lnga pa brda yi sgo phyag dang*// nongs bshags dam bca' gzung ba ni/ hoḥ thabs shes sgo dbye rang rig lha zhal mjal// blo 'das gnyis med rtogs pa'i don phyag 'tshal// 'khrul pa'i dbang gis tha dad 'dzin pa bshags// mi 'bral bsgrub pa'i rdo rje'i g.yar dam gzung*// badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ drug pa ye shes byin chen dbab/ hrīḥ bde chen 'bar ba dbang gi pho brang nas// brgyud gsum bla ma zhi khro yi dam lha// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam tshig can/ khyad par pad+ma ḍā ki gtso 'khor bcas// gdung shugs drags pos thugs dam rgyud bskul na// sgrub gnas dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob// sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang chen skur// sgrub rdzas ye shes phyag rgyar byin gyis rlobs// snang grags chos kun rig pa'i dbang du 'dus// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid thig le chen por rdzogs// gdod nas 'gyur med bde chen 'od gsal ngang*// lhun rdzogs gdal ba chen po'i byin phob cig /badz+ra dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā/ bdun pa mchod brlab gter gzhung ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: gis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'bar ba'i snod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod pa'i bye brag ni: so sor gsal zhing ye shes mchod sprin ni: bde ba skyed cing yid 'phrog 'gugs pa yi: rnam par 'char zhing nus pa can du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: sngags de lan gsum brjod pa yis// mchod brlabs phrin las dngos la 'jug /'di yang dpal nge sprul pa'i sku// chos dbyings mchog gi thugs bzhed ltar// 'chi med bstan gnyis gling pa yis// gang dran shar mar spel ba'i dges// rang snang dbang du 'du bar shog
